== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Naru]] clan is a prominent family that serves as the ruling [[Authority|authority]] of the [[Blackflame Empire]]. They ascended to power approximately fifty years ago following the decline of the original [[Blackflame family]]. Known for their reputation of loyalty, they have become the public face of [[The Empire|the Empire]] and are easily identified by their emerald-colored wings, which are a characteristic of their [[Path of Grasping Sky]]. Members of the clan possess various physical traits, including green eyes, tails, and horns. The clan is led by the Emperor, currently [[Naru Huan]], who holds the titles of [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] and Overlord. The imperial lineage includes the Emperor's mother, a former empress who has since entered seclusion, and his sister, [[Naru Saeya]]. The clan's hierarchy includes [[Underlord|Underlords]], such as [[Naru Gwei]], who serve in high-ranking administrative and military capacities. The [[Naru]] also maintain a system of disciples, often training them in teams, and utilize the [[Blackflame Trials]] for instruction. While they act as the primary administrators of [[The Empire|the Empire]], they also serve as a vassal faction to the [[Akura clan]].}}
